title: Races
subtitle: Keep track of races, plan the next one and never miss a lottery deadline.
disclaimer: Statuses, dates and prices come from organizers and third-party sources and can change. Check the organizer's site before you pay.
nokNote: Amounts marked ≈ are converted to kroner at today's Norges Bank rate.

research.running: Checking the organizer’s pages… this can take a few minutes.
research.unsure: Automatic check {{date}} couldn’t confirm anything, so nothing changed.
research.cooldown: This race was checked recently. Try again later.
research.budget: Today’s research budget is used up. The next check runs tonight.
research.noClaude: Automatic research needs Claude enabled for an admin under Settings → Integrations.
research.about: Every night at 03:30, Claude re-checks tracked races with deadlines coming up daily and the rest of the upcoming catalog every two weeks, and looks for missing races weekly. Changes are applied automatically and logged.
research.monthly: This month’s research budget is used up.
research.last30: Last 30 days: {{cost}} on {{checks}} race checks (avg {{avg}}) and {{discoveries}} searches for new races; {{changes}} changes applied.
research.modelHint: Sonnet is a good balance; Opus is more thorough and costs several times more.
research.nightlyHint: 0 turns off the nightly checks (manual checks still work).
research.homeHint: Travel info and direct-flight badges are written for this airport; existing texts update as races are re-checked.

stride.confirmDelete: Also delete the race from Stride? OK deletes it (it leaves your training plan); Cancel only removes the link.
stride.already: This race is already in Stride.
stride.priorityA: A: the main goal — the plan builds and tapers for it.
stride.priorityB: B: an important race, trained through with a light taper.
stride.priorityC: C: a training race, no taper.
stride.suggest: You’re registered — add it to Stride so your plan builds towards it.

season.title: Your season
season.intro: Races you’re registered for (solid) and considering (dashed), with the time between them.
season.empty: No upcoming races planned yet. Set a race to Planning, In the lottery, Got a place or Registered to see it here.
season.legend: Spacing warnings are rules of thumb; your Stride plan knows your training best.

warning.sameWeek: Two races in the same week.
warning.marathonGap: Less than 8 weeks after another marathon — little time to recover and build again.
warning.shortRecovery: Less than 3 weeks between a marathon and a half — treat one of them as an easy run.
warning.aRaceGap: Two A-race marathons less than 12 weeks apart — hard to peak for both.

qualifying.disclaimer: Standards researched from the organizers on {{date}}. Age is estimated from your birth year and can be a year off. Check the rules before you apply.
